text:
jordan: Heads-up: planning a staged rollout tomorrow for the SDK bridge change that alters streaming boundary events (will add a `stream_end_reason` field). Need owners for canaries, smoke checks, and rollback triggers. Target start 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC.
jordan: High level: 0-5% canary in us-west, then 5-25% in global buckets, then full. If we see parsing errors or client regressions, we immediately revert the gateway config and roll client traffic back.
tara: I can own the SDK-side smoke tests and quick upgrade note for customers. Will verify that old SDKs still parse payloads (they should ignore unknown fields).
kevin: SRE will monitor error-rate, 5xxs, and p50/p95 latency per bucket. I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert if client parsing errors spike >0.5% for 5m.
kevin: Who's toggling the gateway flag? We need a named deployer and a rollback plan with exact commands.
jordan: @anita want to do the gateway toggle and rollforward? You did last month's shim cutover.
anita: I can. Rollforward command is `gatewayctl set-config streaming_v2=true --bucket <bucket>` then `gatewayctl reload`. Rollback is `gatewayctl set-config streaming_v2=false` + reload. I'll prepare a short runbook.
tara: SDK smoke tests I'll run: 1) basic gen+stream end event parsing; 2) chat multi-message streaming; 3) reconnect resume with kv-cache; 4) sample client integration (js, py) parsing unknown field.
jordan: Add these to the smoke checklist. Also need client comms: small note explaining non-breaking change + suggested SDK versions. Tara can draft.
kevin: For observability, please ensure the stream_end_reason is present in logs when applicable. I'll add a log-look that searches for `stream_end_reason` missing in new buckets.
anita: For rollback readiness: I'll keep a terminal window with history of last successful config. If we hit trigger, I will run rollback and ping #oncall and this thread. Expected rollback time <3m.
tara: Draft comms: "We're rolling out a minor streaming telemetry addition (stream_end_reason). This is additive and compatible with older SDKs; upgrade recommended for best experience. Link to migration guide and rolling schedule." I'll post draft here for review in ~30m.
jordan: Who will own client-facing docs update? Need code samples for parsing new field in JS/py.
tara: I'll do the migration guide and add code snippets. ETA a few hours.
kevin: Can we run a quick preflight tonight? Small risk run: spin up two canary buckets with test clients hitting only the new behavior to verify no regressions.
anita: I can allocate two buckets and keep them isolated. What's the test user list?
jordan: Use the internal canary org ids: org-plat-[1001,1002]. Tara, can you run SDK tests against those orgs by 13:00 UTC tomorrow?
tara: Yep, will run and paste results.
kevin: Deploy-bot scheduled message: deploy-bot: rollout-window reserved 2026-03-18 14:00-15:00 UTC, canaries: us-west-1 (5%), global-bucket-2 (20%).
anita: I'll do a dry-run toggle 30m before start to validate control plane perms.
jordan: Last ask: add a quick regression prompt set for quality monitoring (5 prompts that historically catch parsing regressions). Tara, can you pick them?
tara: On it — I'll pick 5 and attach to the quality monitor.
kevin: On-call: if alerts fire, please tag pager duty and escalate to eng-runtime lead. If it's a parsing regression, we prefer rollback vs mitigation.
anita: Copy. I'll be on standby during the window and will post status updates here.
jordan: Thanks all. Post-rollout: 15m smoke window, then confirm and publish client note. If all green, we'll mark SDK-compatible flag in the changelog.
TBD: post-roll call at 14:45 UTC in #eng-platform (10 min).
